title: Default to const, switch to let
why_it_matters: Fewer reassignments means fewer surprise bugs.
explanation: Use const for any value you never reassign, which is most of them. Use let only when the variable must change, like a counter. Reading code gets easier, because const promises that the name always points at the same thing.
try_it: Pick one let in your code, change it to const, and see if anything breaks.
